description: Correct one of the signed-in user's experiment answers without a clinician record (POST /me/experiments/:id/correction). Three uses. (1) A STATUS hold (`statusHold` on supstack_experiments_get, an uncertain pregnancy or breastfeeding status or a follow-up not answered): pass only `renewedScreen` with the answers to `updateAnswer.questions`; a definite answer releases only that hold. (2) A check-in answer chosen BY MISTAKE (nothing happened, nothing is happening now), after the check-in was submitted (`checkInNumber` = progress.completed) or before (`checkInNumber` = the check-in being answered, when the pause came from an answer chosen and not submitted): pass `checkInNumber`, `correctedAnswers` for ONLY the answer(s) the user says were chosen by mistake (pharmacist ruling 281 call 2: another answer or open event that still holds the pause keeps it, and the correction is still recorded: a 200 with `released: false` means the experiment stays paused, relay `note`), optionally `eventIds` for the open events they identified, `renewedScreen` (the warning signs, the pregnancy and breastfeeding status) and `affirmedNoEvent: true` only if the user affirms: "I chose this answer by mistake. None of these symptoms or events happened, and I have none of them now. This corrects my answer. It is not a clinical review." (3) Pharmacist ruling 706: an answer SAVED in a safety report entered BY MISTAKE: pass `reportNumber` (not `checkInNumber`) with `correctedAnswers`, `renewedScreen` and `affirmedNoEvent`, on a paused or an ended experiment: the same audited correction, scoped to that report's own answers and events, with the old and new values, reason, time, channel and resulting state recorded; relay `released` and `remainingHolds`. A real or uncertain symptom is NOT a mistake: use supstack_experiment_restart with the restart record instead. A refusal (409) carries the instruction in `safetyAction`: relay it first, word for word. Never answer for the user. A correction is a data correction, never a clinical review. Pharmacist ruling 410: a 409 `finish_check_in` carries the open check-in's saved answer in `pendingAnswer`, with its `heading` and `instruction` (the event's own action and next-dose guidance): relay that instruction first, word for word, then `message`. Requires the user to be signed in (`supstack login`).
name: supstack_experiment_correct
